hint.follow: Double tap (or double click) a car or its label: it gets picked and the camera follows it. It works even if the car has moved a little between the two taps.
hint.scrub: Two fingers sideways on the map: they move the clock; the full width of the scene is {min} min. To the right goes forward and to the left goes back, without pausing or starting playback.
hint.pinch: Pinch: map zoom or, while following a car, camera distance.
hint.map: Two fingers up and down or diagonally: tilt and turn the map.
